newsitem.title: UK: European raw cotton markets quiet, sellers cautious.
newsitem.headline: European raw cotton markets quiet, sellers cautious.

text.p: Asking prices for raw cotton in Europe remained largely unchanged on Tuesday as evidence of uncovered mill requirements for March-May dissuaded sellers from cutting their rates to attract new business, industry sources said.
The modest increase in New York futures prices on Monday provided further support to current physical market values, they said.
With traders in such cautious mood, most of the enquiry reported was motivated by price-testing, they added.
The Cotlook 'A' Index moved up 0.25 cents per lb, driven by the advance of U.S. origins. --London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8071
